title: Don't Buy That Appliance Protection Plan Until You Watch This!
summary: A short video on appliance protection plans weighs their cost against manufacturer warranties and credit-card coverage, advising skipping them on cheaper appliances.

assertions.quote: protection plans will set you back anywhere from 10 to 30% of the appliance price

verdicts.note: Appliance protection plans are commonly priced around 10-30% of the item's cost, a meaningful fraction relative to the item's value.

assertions.quote: many appliances already come with a manufacturer's warranty that covers defects for a year or even more
it depends if your Appliance is high-end complex or if you just use it a lot a plan might save you money

verdicts.note: Higher-value, more complex, heavily used appliances do have higher expected repair costs, but plan markups often still exceed that added expected value.

assertions.quote: but for cheaper appliances you're probably better off saving that money for future repairs
